title: Stutter / Stop-Stutter
description: Stutter editing drops or repeats frames so playback skips and the world's clock hitches. It is an anxious rhythm, not the lyric smear of step printing and not a jump cut's spatial jump.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Use it when thought itself is damaged: obsession, panic, a headache that cuts time into chips. The picture may stay in the same setup while frames go missing or repeat.
Cadence is the meaning. A little is a twitch.
A lot is a seizure. It is the wrong tool for Wong Kar-wai rain, for Godard-style discontinuous geography, or for stop-motion craft.
If the smear is romantic, you wanted step printing. If the camera angle or body position jumps, you wanted a jump cut.
Do not add a codec glitch unless the story is a broken file.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Start from a clean take, then remove or duplicate frames on a planned irregular grid. You can also skip in camera by lowering sample rate without long-exposure smear.
Keep identity and space continuous so the hitch reads as time, not as a cut. Prompt: Stuttered motion of [Subject], frames dropping or repeating, a glitch in time, anxiety as rhythm.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it when a thought or a panic attack should skip, such as a close face whose blinks do not land on a steady clock. Do not use it as lyric street texture.

sections.title: Compared with similar shots

blocks.text: Stutter is not Step Printing, which reprints long-exposure frames into a smeared delay. It is not a Jump Cut, which discards time and often shows a spatial jump in the same setup.
Stop Motion is pose-to-pose craft. Datamosh is compression damage.
Keep them separate in the prompt.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: Pi uses staccato, high-contrast skipping so numbers and pain share a rhythm. Music videos often stutter a gesture as a beat.
Aronofsky's later montage grammar (Requiem among them) neighbors this hitch without being identical to skip-frame stutter.

sections.title: Prompt it

blocks.text: Write frames dropping or repeating, not smear and not a jump in angle. Still: a face or gesture that looks temporally sampled, slight after-images only if they come from repeats.
Video: Stuttering playback of [Subject], frames repeating and skipping, anxious rhythm. Same setup, no lyric blur, no datamosh.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is Step Printing or Jump Cut. The tell is romantic long-exposure crowds, or a sudden change of body position that reads as an edit.
Fix: keep space continuous and make the cadence irregular. Count the missing frames.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Stutter / Stop-Stutter in film?
Stutter is playback that drops or repeats frames so time hitches. The setup usually stays put while the clock skips.
Stutter vs Step Printing
Step printing is smeared, lyric, duplicated-frame delay. Stutter is anxious skip-or-repeat rhythm without requiring long-exposure texture.
When should I use Stutter?
When panic, obsession, or pain should make the mind skip. Keep the same setup so the hitch is temporal.
How do I prompt Stutter for AI image or video?
Write frames repeating and skipping, anxious rhythm, same camera setup. Forbid smooth slow motion, romantic smear, and jump-cut geography.
